items.description: Investigating the 'Lost in the Middle' phenomenon in LLMs on factoid texts using NaturalQuestions with Llama 3.1 8B Instruct. Extending validation to complete RAG pipelines on non-factoid texts using modified MS MARCO 2.1 dataset from TREC RAG 2024 benchmark.
Led 10+ AI automation & CRM reporting initiatives. Redesigned KPI reporting and automated workflows, saving 1–4 hours daily and boosting process efficiency by 60% across 30+ stakeholders.
